findings.description: Direct inspection of all five V183 views and six pose renders shows pronounced folded/faceted overskirt panels in neutral and posed views. Crouch lifts the skirt above the fitted shorts across the front, and sit bunches the skirt behind the pelvis while both shorts and upper thighs remain broadly exposed. The declared thigh-surface placement did not resolve pose coverage or garment drape. This is prototype render evidence only and does not establish fit.

Gray body-colored patches and abrupt hard facets remain visible across the ivory chest and waist in the front, three-quarter, arm-cross, crouch, and sit renders. Their origin is not established by these renders; visible bodice surface quality remains unacceptable.

nextAction: Keep V183 rejected. Do not treat the thigh placement as an accepted fit fix: despite activation, direct crouch/sit renders still expose the fitted shorts and thighs and show severe overskirt bunching/faceting. Inspect the exact posed overskirt source and panel simulation/attachment behavior before a single bounded construction change. Separately identify the bodice gray-patch/facet source before changing bodice geometry or material. Preserve mandatory fit, bone/weight, Shape Key, Unity/VRChat, package, and release gates.
